choice_data_list: You're full of energy this morning!
You're full of energy this morning!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because I got plenty of rest! I was 
able to absorb a lot of good inspiration, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I just watched that blockbuster 
everyone's talking about at the cinema! 
And then I bought a manga just for its 
cool cover, and wow, it was sooo good!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to unleash this passion right away! 
In my creations! And in my races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki seemed eager to get moving. It 
looks like she had a fulfilling day off!
